entities.name: Vlatko Čančar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vlatko Čančar is a Slovenian professional basketball player who last played for Olimpia Milano of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA) and the EuroLeague. Standing at 6 ft 8 in (2.03 m), he plays primarily as a small forward. He has previously played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) for the Denver Nuggets, winning the NBA Finals with them in 2023.
